units.text: The CBO projects the debt held by the public rising from about 101% of the economy this year to 120% by 2036, higher than at any point in American history.

units.text: The real question isn't whether America can borrow.

units.text: So what do you think?

units.text: Is $40 trillion a ticking time bomb, or a problem America will fix in time?
